shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'ls -la && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat vite.config.ts && cat tsconfig.json && find .. -name AGENTS.md -print'

/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/uikit version dist-tags --json && git status --short && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeSettingsContext.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts'

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Provider/Provider.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs | head -35 && cat index.html'

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build | rg '(Provider.d.ts|theme/types.d.ts|docs/INDEX.md|Switch/README)' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts && cat index.html"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"for (const name of ['playwright', '@playwright/test', 'puppeteer', 'jsdom']) { try { console.log(name + ': ' + import.meta.resolve(name)) } catch {} }\" && ls /tmp && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/App.tsx src/main.tsx package.json index.html"
